title: Tech Video Spec
description: Derived from scripts/lib/manifest.mjs by scripts/gen-schema.mjs — do not edit by hand. A FLOOR check (shape + enums + string budgets); scripts/lint-spec.mjs owns the deeper rules.

theme.description: the DARK skin (light variant renders automatically)

assetsNeeded.description: Asset-request protocol: declare a needed asset instead of inventing a URL. A media field then references it as "needed:<key>".

query.description: what to search for — never a URL

stages.description: 3-6 stage names in order, e.g. IF ID EX MEM WB (each short, <=4 chars)

value.description: numeric only — it counts up; '160K' as a string never animates

notes.description: 1-6 notes; each {title?<=28, tag?<=20, body<=180, highlight? (a verbatim phrase inside body, <=70), asset? (lucide:/si:/img:), color?, atWord?}

columns.description: board columns override (else responsive by count + aspect)

from.description: 1-10; counts down to the go word

xAxis.description: labels ≤6 chars, align to values by index

unit.description: appended to each value, e.g. % or k

stages.description: 2-6 × {label≤18, sub?≤28, asset?, status?≤12, badge?≤14, ms?≤8, reason?≤40, color?}

logos.description: 3-15 × {icon:si:|lucide:, label?≤16, atWord} — IP: brand logos are si: only

content.description: ContentSlot — pick a kind + its fields (every kind allows title≤40): text{body≤120} · form{fields≤4:[{label≤14,value,focus?}],submit?} · cardGrid{cards≤6:[{title≤16,sub≤22,status?,meta?,asset?}]} · metric{value≤8,label≤18} · notification{app≤14,text≤40} · empty{message≤40}

ContentSlot (page under test) — a kind + fields (title≤40): text{body≤120} · form{fields≤4:[{label≤14,value,focus?}],submit?} · cardGrid{cards≤6:[{title≤16,sub≤22,status?,meta?,asset?}]} · metric{value≤8,label≤18} · empty{message≤40}

ContentSlot (phone screen) — a kind + fields (title≤40): text{body≤120} · form{fields≤4:[{label≤14,value,focus?}],submit?} · cardGrid{cards≤6:[{title≤16,sub≤22,status?,meta?,asset?}]} · metric{value≤8,label≤18} · notification{app≤14,text≤40} · empty{message≤40}

tables.description: ≤4 × {id, name≤18, columns:[≤6 × {name≤18, type?≤12, key?:'pk'|'fk'}], col?, row?}

lean.description: -1..1 — negative favours LEFT (left sinks), positive favours RIGHT, 0 balanced

blocks.description: 2-12 × {label≤18, sub?≤14, x,y,w,h (1-based grid, must fit cols×rows), color?}

failIndex.description: node that expands its expected/actual pair

focusId.description: id of the overview node to push into

featured.description: a symbol to feature as a hero card (must match an entry)

metrics.description: 2-4 × {label≤18, value:number, target?, unit?, degrading? (only ONE), color?}

tiles.description: 2-6 tiles (2-4 for variant:'clips') × {asset (or src), kind?:'video'|'image', label≤18, color?}

src.description: clip path (public/), e.g. assets/video/demo.mp4 (missing → designed placeholder)

callouts.description: 1-5 × {x:0..1, y:0..1, label≤32, side?:'left'|'right'|'up'|'down', hw?, hh?, color?, atWord?}

shots.description: 2-4 × {src?, kind?:video|image, label≤40, color?, atWord?, highlight?:{x,y,w,h in 0..1}}
